intro.title: About Us
intro.subtitle: Agricultural machinery parts importer and distributor in Greece since 1980. We offer compatible parts for tractors, strippers, harvesters, and cotton machines with nationwide shipping.

history.title: Our History
history.description_1: Our company, I. & K. Psoma OE, was founded in 1980 and has evolved from a small family business into one of the leading importers of agricultural machinery parts in Greece.
history.description_2: From the beginning, our goal was to satisfy the Greek farmer by providing high-quality products and options at competitive prices. Over the years, we have built strong relationships with suppliers worldwide, giving us the ability to offer a wide range of parts.
history.description_3: Today we serve customers ranging from small family farms to large agricultural companies throughout Greece and abroad, maintaining our commitment to quality, reliability, and excellent service.

mission_vision.title: Our Mission & Vision

mission.title: Mission:
mission.description: To bridge the gap between international suppliers and Greek agricultural businesses, providing reliable access to quality parts that enhance productivity and sustainability.

vision.title: Vision:
vision.description: To become the most trusted partner for agricultural machinery parts in Greece, recognized for our experience, quality products, and commitment to customer success.

mission_vision.belief: We believe that by providing access to the best agricultural technology and components, we contribute to the development and sustainability of Greek agriculture.

what_sets_us_apart.title: What Sets Us Apart
what_sets_us_apart.subtitle: With emphasis on quality, service, and our long-standing experience, we serve the needs of every agricultural professional.

features.title: 40+ Years of Experience
features.description: Long-standing presence in the field of agricultural machinery.

features.title: 10,000+ Parts

features.title: Personalized Service
features.description: We search and recommend the right part for every need.
